findings.summary: Invertibility of H (and the positivity and lower bound on H⁻¹T_{0,*}) is proved only on carrier L ∩ closure(active shell, q∈[1/2,2]) ∩ {T>0}. The paper claims invertibility throughout each enlarged slow neighborhood.

No exported declaration states the derivative half of (7.25), |D^I y_σ| ≤ C_I S_*^{b_I} ζ δ^{-a_I}, for the actual y_σ = H⁻¹T_{0,*}. Only generic or conditional jet lemmas exist, and they are used inside other proofs.

The W_0-level claims hold only after multiplication by η_β. The covariance identity is C(η_β W_0) = ε η_β² T_{0,*} (and only where ζ>0), and the W_{1/2} jets are for the η_β-masked field. The paper's unmasked (7.26) and its unmasked estimates are never stated.
Clause (iv) is about a_σ itself. Lean proves smooth zero extension at the shell edges only for the full field outerCutoff·η_β·√ε·a_σ·χ_g·t^h_σ. Nothing states it for a_σ = √y_σ.
